_meta.purpose: Meat and milk WITHDRAWAL reference for drugs used in this flock. Consumed read-only by scripts/withdrawal_check.py to compute the earliest date a treated animal's meat/milk may enter the food supply.
_meta.food_safety_rule: This file is the single source of withdrawal intervals. Numbers here are VET/OPERATOR-OWNED, not agent-authored. An entry with withdrawal_days=null and status NEEDS_VET_CONFIRMATION means the interval has NOT been confirmed and the engine will report any animal treated with that drug as UNKNOWN — never as clear. The tool never asserts an animal is safe to slaughter/milk; it computes the earliest clear date from a CONFIRMED interval, or names the gap.
_meta.extra_label_warning: Most drugs are used EXTRA-LABEL in sheep (approved for cattle/other species). Extra-label use REQUIRES a veterinary withdrawal interval — commonly LONGER than any label figure — obtained from the prescribing vet or FARAD (Food Animal Residue Avoidance Databank, farad.org / 1-888-USFARAD). Do NOT copy a cattle label figure into this file.
_meta.how_to_confirm: For each entry with status NEEDS_VET_CONFIRMATION: obtain the meat (and milk, for a lactating ewe) withdrawal interval for THIS formulation, route, and dose from your vet or FARAD, enter it in withdrawal_days_meat / withdrawal_days_milk, set status to 'vet_confirmed', and record who confirmed it and when in confirmed_by / confirmed_date.

schema.drug_key: lowercase match token (substring, matched against the free-text treatment string)
schema.class: anthelmintic | antibiotic | coccidiostat | vaccine | nutritional | other
schema.withdrawal_days_meat: integer days, or null if unconfirmed
schema.withdrawal_days_milk: integer days, or null if unconfirmed or not applicable
schema.confirmed_by: person who confirmed a vet_confirmed interval (else null)
